paite: Alupna tung ua thulimlouhna gelmi leh thil hoih lou ngaihtuahkhemi tung agik hi; zingsang a khua avak in huai ahih zel uhi.
heading: Genthei Nuaisiahte Tan Ding
english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

paite: Miloute eng in alaksak ua; innte a-eng ua, alaksak zel uhi; mi leh a-inkote uh mi leh agoutan un anuaisiah uhi.
english: They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'n hichi in achi: “Ngai dih, hiai inko tung ah thil hoih lou ka gel ahi, huai a kipan in na ngawng uh na suan kei ding ua, kisatheitak in apai nawn kei ding uh; hun hoih lou ahih ding ziak in.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.

paite: Huai ni chiang in noute dem in gentehna abawl ding ua, kahla khasiathuai a sam in; "Suksiat in i om vekta ua, ka mite thil tan akilamdangta; kei kipan gam lakmang ahi a; helhatmi kiang ah i lou uh hawmzak ahita," achi ding uhi.
english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA mite kikhawmte lak ah aisan a khau a tehsak mi kuamah na nei kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the assembly of Yahweh.

paite: Thu gen kei un, chi in agen zel ua, hiai mite kiang ah thu agen kei ding uh; gensiatna adai kei ding hi.
english: “Don’t prophesy!” They prophesy. “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote aw, TOUPA kha nehden in a-om a hia? Hiaite athilhih chih ding ahi maw? Diktak a om zel mi tung ah ka thute'n thil hoih ahih kei maw?
english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob: “Is the Spirit of Yahweh angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

paite: Himahleh ka mite tunai chin in melma bang in ahong dingkhia uhi; kidou ding lungsim a nei lou, muangtak a vialvakte lak a kipan in apuansilh puanaktualte uh na suahsak uhi.
english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

paite: Ka mi numeite a-inn nuamtak ua kipan na delhkhia ua; anaupang neute a kipan ka thupina alamang den uhi.
english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

paite: Thou unla, paimang un; hiai khawlna mun ding ahi kei a; siatna thupitak tan ahi, buahna a-om ziak in.
english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

paite: Mi kuahiam in kha a om chi a zuauthu gen in, "Uain leh zu na taina ding uh ahi," chi in hong gen taleh huai mi, mipite zaknop lel thugen zawlnei ahi ding hi.
english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink”; he would be the prophet of this people.

paite: Aw Jakobte, na vek un ka hon samkhawm ding a; Israel khosuak-sunte ka pikhawm ding a; Bozrah khua belam bang a koihkhawm ding; ganhonte aloupa mun ua om bang in, mipi ahih ziak un achiak zuazua ding uh.
english: I will surely assemble, Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture; they will swarm with people.

paite: Ama uah lampi phuvangpa apai a; aphu pailet ua, kongkhak pha in apai zel ua, huai ah apaikhia uhi; akumpipa uh ama uah apai a, TOUPA'N ama uh akai hi.
english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. And their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.
